svg.title: NervROS: Talk to your ROS 2 robot
svg.desc: An animated mission-control banner. A LiDAR sweep rotates over a point-cloud plan of a six-room apartment while a Unitree G1 marker walks the mission "bring the mug to the tray": go to the dining table, pick the mug, go to the office, place it in the tray. A step ticker on the right checks off each step. The wordmark NervROS and the tagline Talk to your ROS 2 robot are on the left.

g.text: It looks, plans and acts, once you approve.
